name: playthrough-chain-nat
purpose: iter-465 playthrough lane: the NATURAL twin of playthrough_chain_pf.json (port features off, no mods): title -> START -> the game's own LOAD A GAME? popup -> A = START NEW GAME -> the plan (tools/devtools/playthrough_plan.py output, pad step kept) walks the story spine; SR_LEVELSKIP_DECLINE_SAVES=1 answers the other save prompts Continue Without Saving. Dev-tool assisted. Gates: SR_INSTANCE_ID=playthrough,SR_PORT_FEATURES=0,SR_MODS=0,SR_DEVTOOLS=levelskip+cheats,SR_DEVTOOLS_CMDS=<abs plan>,SR_DEVTOOLS_OUT=<dir>,SR_LEVELSKIP_DECLINE_SAVES=1,SDL_AUDIODRIVER=disk. -TimeoutSeconds 4800.
